# UltrafastEngine

> Engine for nonlinear ultrafast pulse propagation through optical systems (stretchers, compressors, plates, gas cells, crystals, amplifiers, oscillators, interferometers), with a command line (`ultrafast`), a C API, a Python package (`ultrafast`) and plugins. Inputs: a system file (.ufs) and a run spec (run.json); outputs: summary.json, result.npz. Install: `pip install --pre ultrafast-engine`.

Start with the agent guide, then the reference page for what you write. Every page is on https://josephcodemard.github.io/UltrafastEngine/ .

## Start here
- [For AI agents](https://josephcodemard.github.io/UltrafastEngine/agents/): how to write system files and run specs, run, read results, MCP server
- [Getting started](https://josephcodemard.github.io/UltrafastEngine/getting-started/)
